statement.zh: Khan「Excavations at Kot Diji」(Pakistan Archaeology 2, 1965) 报告科特迪吉早期层叠压于成熟哈拉帕层之下，成为早期哈拉帕典型参照。
statement.en: Khan’s “Excavations at Kot Diji” (Pakistan Archaeology 2, 1965) reports Early (Kot Dijian) levels beneath Mature Harappan, establishing a key Early Harappan type-site.
